description: Defines the QuicStreamSequencerBuffer class, a circular buffer for managing stream data in QUIC protocol implementation, including methods for buffering, reading, and managing stream data segments.

classes.name: quic::QuicStreamSequencerBuffer
classes.description: A thread-unsafe circular buffer for managing stream data segments in QUIC, supporting random writes and in-sequence reads with memory management.

classes.name: quic::QuicStreamSequencerBuffer::BufferBlock
classes.description: A basic storage block used within QuicStreamSequencerBuffer, consisting of a fixed-size character buffer.

methods.name: QuicStreamSequencerBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing buffer with maximum capacity.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Frees the space used to buffer data.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Checks if the buffer has no data to read.

methods.name: OnStreamData
methods.description: Buffers new stream data at a specified offset, returning success or error code.

methods.name: Readv
methods.description: Reads data into an iovec array, returning number of bytes read.

methods.name: GetReadableRegions
methods.description: Retrieves multiple readable data regions as iovec structures.

methods.name: GetReadableRegion
methods.description: Retrieves a single readable data region.

methods.name: PeekRegion
methods.description: Provides a pointer to data at a specific offset without consuming it.

methods.name: MarkConsumed
methods.description: Marks a number of bytes as consumed.

methods.name: FlushBufferedFrames
methods.description: Deletes and marks as consumed all buffered data.

methods.name: ReleaseWholeBuffer
methods.description: Frees all buffered data memory.

methods.name: HasBytesToRead
methods.description: Checks if there are bytes available to read.

methods.name: BytesConsumed
methods.description: Returns total bytes read out of the buffer.

methods.name: BytesBuffered
methods.description: Returns current number of bytes in buffer.

methods.name: ReadableBytes
methods.description: Returns number of bytes available to read.

methods.name: FirstMissingByte
methods.description: Returns offset of the first missing byte.

methods.name: NextExpectedByte
methods.description: Returns offset of the highest received byte plus one.

methods.name: ReceivedFramesDebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of all received frames.

methods.name: CopyStreamData
methods.description: Copies data into internal buffers, returning success or error.

methods.name: RetireBlock
methods.description: Disposes of a buffer block.

methods.name: RetireBlockIfEmpty
methods.description: Retires a block if it contains no data.

methods.name: GetBlockCapacity
methods.description: Calculates capacity of a block at a given index.

methods.name: GetBlockIndex
methods.description: Calculates block index from stream offset.

methods.name: GetInBlockOffset
methods.description: Calculates offset within a block from stream offset.

methods.name: ReadOffset
methods.description: Returns offset relative to the first block for next read.

methods.name: NextBlockToRead
methods.description: Returns index of the next block to read.

methods.name: MaybeAddMoreBlocks
methods.description: Resizes internal block list if needed.
